mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shops (name, is_template, create_time, expires_at, visitor_key) VALUES (#{name}, #{isTemplate}, #{createTime}, #{expiresAt}, #{visitorKey})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, is_template, create_time, expires_at, visitor_key FROM shops WHERE visitor_key = #{visitorKey} AND is_template = 0 AND expires_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE shops SET visitor_key = NULL WHERE id = #{shopId} AND is_template = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, name, role, shop_id FROM admin WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND role = 'admin' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (id, shop_id, name, parent_id, sort_order, status, recommend, image) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, name, CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE shop_id = 1) THEN parent_id + #{offset} ELSE NULL END, sort_order, status, recommend, image FROM categories WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO tags (id, shop_id, name, code, type, color, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, created_by, update_time, updated_by) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, name, CASE WHEN code IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(code, '_s', #{shopId}) END, type, color, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, created_by, update_time, updated_by FROM tags WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO products (id, shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, stock, description, image, body, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, cost_price, product_code, weight, volume, create_time, update_time) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, category_id + #{offset}, tag_id + #{offset}, name, sub_title, brand, stock, description, image, body, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, cost_price, product_code, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO stock (id, shop_id, product_id, min_stock, max_stock, alert_enabled, create_time, update_time) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, product_id + #{offset}, min_stock, max_stock, alert_enabled, create_time, update_time FROM stock WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO `user` (id, shop_id, openid, name, phone, sex, avatar, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, CONCAT('sb_', #{shopId}, '_', id), CONCAT('体验用户', id), NULL, sex, NULL, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO address (id, shop_id, user_id, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, user_id + #{offset}, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM address WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO orders (id, shop_id, user_id, order_no, pay_amount, pay_type, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, order_status, is_deleted, remark, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, user_id + #{offset}, CONCAT(order_no, '_s', #{shopId}), pay_amount, pay_type, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, order_status, is_deleted, remark, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO order_items (id, shop_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, sub_total, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, is_deleted, created_at) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, order_id + #{offset}, product_id + #{offset}, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, sub_total, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, is_deleted, created_at FROM order_items WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO cart (id, shop_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id + #{offset}, #{shopId}, user_id + #{offset}, product_id + #{offset}, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at FROM cart WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO after_sales (id, order_id, after_sale_no, order_no, after_sale_type, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted, reason, remark, images, merchant_remark, shop_id) SELECT id + #{offset}, order_id + #{offset}, CONCAT(after_sale_no, '_s', #{shopId}), CONCAT(order_no, '_s', #{shopId}), after_sale_type, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted, reason, remark, images, merchant_remark, #{shopId} FROM after_sales WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO after_sale_items (id, after_sale_id, order_item_id, product_id, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, refund_amount, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted, shop_id) SELECT id + #{offset}, after_sale_id + #{offset}, order_item_id + #{offset}, product_id + #{offset}, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, refund_amount, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted, #{shopId} FROM after_sale_items WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO after_sale_returns (id, after_sale_id, return_way, return_time_slot, return_at, review_at, rejected_at, refund_at, refunded_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted, shop_id) SELECT id + #{offset}, after_sale_id + #{offset}, return_way, return_time_slot, return_at, review_at, rejected_at, refund_at, refunded_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted, #{shopId} FROM after_sale_returns WHERE shop_id = 1

INSERT INTO after_sale_exchange_returns (id, after_sale_id, return_way, return_time_slot, created_at, updated_at, review_at, return_at, exchange_at, exchanged_at, rejected_at, is_deleted, shop_id) SELECT id + #{offset}, after_sale_id + #{offset}, return_way, return_time_slot, created_at, updated_at, review_at, return_at, exchange_at, exchanged_at, rejected_at, is_deleted, #{shopId} FROM after_sale_exchange_returns WHERE shop_id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM shops WHERE is_template = 0 AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < #{now} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shops WHERE id = #{shopId} AND is_template = 0
